I'm blocked on permissions — both routes to arXiv need your approval before I can proceed:

1. **`Bash(curl ...)`** — to download `https://arxiv.org/e-print/2602.01234` (the TeX source tarball)
2. **`WebFetch`** — to hit `https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.01234`

Neither has been granted, so nothing has been fetched yet.

**What I'd do once approved:**
- `curl -sSL -o 2602.01234.tar.gz https://arxiv.org/e-print/2602.01234` — this is the e-print endpoint, which returns the submitted LaTeX source, not the PDF
- Unpack it, find the main `.tex` file, and resolve any `\input`/`\include` children
- Read the full text so we can go through it together

Two things worth flagging up front:

- **The ID may not resolve.** `2602.01234` maps to February 2026. That's in the past relative to today, so it's plausible, but I can't confirm the paper exists until a request actually goes out. If it 404s I'll tell you rather than guess at contents.
- **Some submissions have no TeX source.** If it was submitted as PDF-only, `e-print` returns a PDF and there's no LaTeX to extract. I'll say so if that happens instead of silently falling back to the PDF, since you were explicit about wanting source.

Approve either permission (curl is the better path — WebFetch converts to markdown and would mangle a binary tarball) and I'll pull it down.
